issues.detail: 14 manifest-declared source PNGs are absent; 36 native exports are present and hash-verified. Editing/re-generation cannot be assumed safe until sources are restored or provenance is re-pinned.
13 proposal items, six recipes and five one-time HN/EX sources are legacy VP/HN data; none is automatically a VG01–VG11 release.
GDD names eight item groups across five realms, four artifact families × three milestones, six equipment slots, currencies and inner-realm systems; current icon inventory does not cover this set.
Review/QA coverage proves reuse candidates and provenance, not ART, motion, VFX, balance, loot or runtime approval.
24 PNGs contain artifact icons, progression/mastery icons and portraits; they must not be counted as 24 materials/items.
Vân Ngọc background is owner-approved in original scope; world library is empty and no navigation/collision/placement may be inferred.
Mặc Dực, Bào Tử Giữ Khí and Tĩnh Niệm Tro appear in prior roster but GDD 0.35 has no finalized sink; keep as pending candidates.
